definitions.gloss: rice husk; rice chaff; rice hull
definitions.explanation: The dry, papery outer hull separated from rice grains during hulling. Often used as mulch, fuel, or packing material.

examples.japanese: {籾殻|もみがら}を{畑|はたけ}にまく。
examples.english: I spread rice husks on the field.

examples.japanese: {籾殻|もみがら}は{燃料|ねんりょう}としても{使|つか}われる。
examples.english: Rice husks are also used as fuel.

examples.japanese: {昔|むかし}は{卵|たまご}を{籾殻|もみがら}の{中|なか}に{入|い}れて{運|はこ}んだ。
examples.english: In the old days, eggs were carried packed in rice husks.

notes:
The dry, papery outer hull of a rice grain, separated from the rice during hulling. Composed of {籾|もみ} (unhulled rice) + {殻|から} (husk, shell).

COMMON USES:
- {肥料|ひりょう}: fertilizer / soil conditioner
- {燃料|ねんりょう}: fuel
- {緩衝材|かんしょうざい}: cushioning / packing material

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {糠|ぬか}: rice bran — the powdery layer beneath the husk, removed when polishing rice
- {籾|もみ}: unhulled rice — rice still in its husk
